additional_info.subject: 0382475 - ID0382475-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / PD 170001321] Charging session terminated CRM:00658000760
additional_info.body:
Dear Marnic,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Saurav
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / PD 170001321
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
7UU7cO
Problem Description
: Charging session terminated
For future reference, your ticket number is
0382475
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We have checked the logs for the time stamp you mentioned and found that charging session stopped due to invalid Id tag.
As authorization is off for outlet 2, charger did not receive any ID tag information .
But Id tag is mandatory in StartTransaction message. where the value was empty. So backend rejected the transaction and stopped the session.
Outlet was already in C2 state and output contractors are closed so we received output voltage too high message which was resolved within seconds as voltage come down.
